meta.title: Circuit2VST
meta.description: Turns a hand-drawn circuit into VST3/AU/CLAP plugins: checks the toolchain, fetches the pinned rustomp framework and this platform's packer, scaffolds a project, imports a netlist, regenerates code and runs the platform packer. Includes a panel designer (canvas, properties, layers, validation) that exports ui.toml and 12 px/mm artwork.
